title: Reddit r/forhire — RegenExcalibur Multidisciplinary AI & Technical Work
copy:
[For Hire] RegenExcalibur — Multidisciplinary AI Research, Automation, Technical Systems, Documentation, Construction-Tech & Cross-Domain Problem Solving | US$20–35+/hr

**RegenExcalibur is actively looking for paid freelance, contract, research, technical, creative, operational, and project work.**

I’m Justice Gray Maciocha, founder/operator of RegenExcalibur and **1JGM — Blueprint-to-Bot Systems Operator**, based in Alberta, Canada. RegenExcalibur is a clean-tech and AI-oriented systems venture, and I’m opening its capabilities to clients who need difficult work researched, structured, documented, prototyped, coordinated, tested, or made easier through modern AI and software.

The central service is broader than one occupation: **give me a legitimate problem, objective, workflow, research question, technical bottleneck, documentation burden, design challenge, or multidisciplinary project, and I can determine how AI, research methods, software, automation, structured workflows, and human review can be coordinated to attack it efficiently.**

AI can work across an enormous range of academic, occupational, technical, creative, and operational domains because the underlying capabilities — research, classification, synthesis, drafting, coding assistance, comparison, simulation, planning, visualization, documentation, QA, translation, workflow design, and tool orchestration — are reusable. I use those capabilities to coordinate domain-specific work while distinguishing AI-assisted capability from professional licensure or credentials.

## WHAT REGENEXCALIBUR CAN COORDINATE

**AI / LLM systems** — prompt engineering, context architecture, multi-agent workflows, structured outputs, model comparison, evaluation rubrics, AI QA, hallucination/error checking, human-in-the-loop systems, knowledge workflows, tool-use planning, evidence gates, reusable prompt libraries, AI operating procedures, and AI-assisted production pipelines.

**Deep research & intelligence** — market research, competitor intelligence, product research, technology landscapes, academic literature mapping, opportunity discovery, supplier research, pricing analysis, grant/funding research, partnership research, Web3 research, clean-tech research, construction-tech research, software/tool comparisons, source verification, evidence matrices, claim ledgers, timelines, executive briefs, and decision-ready synthesis.

**Software / automation / APIs** — AI-assisted Python and JavaScript prototyping, JSON/YAML, schemas, REST/API concepts, FastAPI, MCP concepts, OAuth/integration planning, browser-automation architecture, GitHub workflows, CI troubleshooting, tests, logs, internal tools, data transformation, automation discovery, workflow mapping, exception handling, approval gates, recovery paths, and technical specifications.

**Technical writing / knowledge systems** — PRDs, requirements, specifications, SOPs, checklists, runbooks, README files, API documentation, architecture notes, implementation plans, troubleshooting guides, onboarding material, policies, research reports, risk registers, evidence registers, decision logs, release-readiness reports, training material, technical explainers, proposals, comparison studies, and complex information rewritten for non-technical audiences.

**Data / QA / information operations** — spreadsheet cleanup, normalization, deduplication, categorization, taxonomy design, listing audits, URL checks, missing-field detection, price/feature matrices, structured extraction, quality rubrics, defect taxonomies, correction queues, completion matrices, throughput/rework/blocker tracking, evidence review, and repeatable quality-control processes.

**Project / product / operations coordination** — turn ambiguous goals into requirements, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, owners, blockers, acceptance criteria, handoffs, status reports, risk registers, issue triage, decision gates, completion evidence, implementation sequences, and next-action plans.

**Construction / built environment** — approximately eight years of field experience including residential framing across 80+ homes, basement foundation formwork, junior HDD/utilities support, construction-material logistics, landscaping/property work, measurement, layout, sequencing, staging, quality awareness, field troubleshooting, plan interpretation, and rework prevention. I can translate field reality into digital workflows, checklists, process maps, training content, preconstruction research, QA systems, material/trade matrices, and construction-tech concepts.

**CAD / design / visualization / fabrication workflows** — foundational AutoCAD training, SketchUp Web, Blender, AI visualization, floor plans, spatial concepts, residential option studies, presentation concepts, image-to-depth/mesh research, STL/3D-print workflow planning, slicing/connectors/scale concepts, and construction-informed design iteration. I have created and iterated 300+ early-stage residential concepts. This is design/visualization and technical coordination support, not stamped architecture or professional engineering.

**Clean technology / environmental systems** — research, concept architecture, technical documentation, monitoring/MRV workflow design, carbon-aware construction concepts, sensor/data workflow research, prototype planning, evidence systems, technology comparisons, and multidisciplinary clean-tech ideation.

**Business / founder operations** — market maps, competitive research, product/service architecture, customer/problem research, business-process mapping, opportunity analysis, proposal preparation, technical sales material, pitch structure, documentation systems, workflow automation, research operations, and evidence-backed decision support.

**Creative / media / communication** — scripts, technical storytelling, educational material, presentation architecture, naming, concept development, structured ideation, research-driven writing, trades/DIY content, shot lists, demonstrations, B-roll plans, explainers, training content, visual-development prompts, and cross-disciplinary creative projects.

**Learning / education / academic support** — terminology maps, literature maps, study frameworks, structured explanations, knowledge graphs, comparison tables, research plans, curricula, examples/counterexamples, technical summaries, and interdisciplinary synthesis. I will not perform dishonest academic submissions or misrepresent AI work as a student’s independent work.

**Security / governance / compliance documentation** — threat-model support, risk documentation, least-privilege concepts, authorization matrices, audit/evidence workflows, privacy-aware process design, incident/runbook documentation, redaction planning, provenance, rollback planning, and safe automation architecture. This is technical/governance support, not a claim of licensed legal advice, certified auditing, or independent penetration-testing authority.

And that list is intentionally not exhaustive.

## THE CROSS-DISCIPLINARY METHOD

I do **not** claim that one person or one AI magically possesses every professional credential. The capability I offer is the ability to **coordinate intelligence across disciplines**.

For an unfamiliar occupation, academic field, industry, or technical problem, I can:

1. Define the objective, deliverable, constraints, stakeholders, and success criteria.
2. Map the relevant disciplines, occupations, academic fields, terminology, standards, software, tools, and authoritative sources.
3. Decompose the problem into specialist workstreams.
4. Use AI and software to accelerate research, comparison, drafting, coding assistance, analysis, visualization, documentation, testing, and iteration.
5. Build evidence/source registers so verified facts, client statements, assumptions, inference, and unknowns remain distinguishable.
6. Test outputs against edge cases, counterexamples, contradictions, failure modes, and acceptance criteria.
7. Identify where a licensed engineer, architect, lawyer, clinician, accountant, security professional, scientist, or other credentialed specialist must review or authorize the result.
8. Package the result into something useful: a report, prototype, workflow, specification, SOP, spreadsheet, research brief, design concept, implementation plan, QA package, presentation, or decision system.

This makes disciplines that may initially look inaccessible **more feasible to research, structure, communicate, prototype, and coordinate with the correct technology and software** — without pretending that AI replaces legally required professional authority.

## EXAMPLES OF THE COORDINATION I CAN APPLY

A messy business process → map it → identify bottlenecks → design an automation → specify tools/APIs → create human approval gates → document the SOP → test failure cases.

A new market → identify competitors → collect pricing/features → normalize data → analyze positioning → find gaps → produce an executive opportunity brief.

A construction workflow → translate field sequence into digital instructions → material/trade matrix → QA checklist → training content → automation opportunities.

A software idea → requirements → architecture → repository structure → AI-assisted prototype → tests → documentation → risk review → deployment plan.

A research question → terminology map → source hierarchy → literature/evidence collection → competing hypotheses → structured synthesis → uncertainty register → decision-ready report.

A technical product → research → specifications → user documentation → troubleshooting → QA cases → presentation → customer-facing explanation.

A large ambiguous project → decompose disciplines → assign specialist AI roles → establish evidence and review gates → coordinate artifacts → reconcile contradictions → produce a final integrated package.

A repetitive office task → classify inputs → define decision rules → automate safe steps → preserve human review for consequential actions → measure errors/rework → improve the workflow.

A concept that requires knowledge I do not yet possess → perform deep research → identify the correct software and specialists → build a bounded prototype or documentation package → expose uncertainties → iterate from evidence.

## SELECTED EVIDENCE

• Designed governed AI workflows covering intake, specialist-role routing, evidence, approvals, QA, auditability, security boundaries, rollback, and verification.
• Produced PRDs, technical specifications, schemas, SOPs, checklists, test plans, threat models, risk/evidence registers, runbooks, decision records, and release-readiness reports.
• Directed AI-assisted Python/JavaScript, API, repository, GitHub, CI, testing, and integration work while distinguishing local proof from production readiness.
• A portfolio prototype passed local Python compilation, 11/11 unit tests, 5/5 behavioural cases, deliberate tamper detection, artifact hashing, and local HTTP smoke tests.
• Approximately eight years of construction/field experience across 80+ homes.
• 300+ early-stage residential concepts using construction knowledge, drafting foundations, SketchUp, Blender, and AI-assisted visualization methods.

## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR

RegenExcalibur is looking for **real paid problems to solve**: freelance assignments, contract work, research projects, technical documentation, AI operations, automation discovery, prototype coordination, construction-tech support, data/QA work, product research, founder support, interdisciplinary projects, and unusual problems where a strong research-and-systems approach can create value.

Remote and asynchronous work is ideal. I currently work daytime construction shifts, so I am especially interested in deliverable-based projects that can be completed evenings/weekends rather than requiring continuous daytime presence.

## RATES / ENGAGEMENT

• US$20/hr starting point for structured research, data cleanup, listing/URL QA, and administrative information work.
• US$25–35+/hr for technical documentation, AI QA, workflow/automation specifications, project operations, construction-tech, research-intensive, and multidisciplinary technical work depending on complexity.
• Fixed-price milestones welcome.
• Small **paid** trial projects welcome when scope, acceptance criteria, deadline, and payment are clear.

I use AI aggressively as a productivity and research multiplier where the client/platform permits it, but I personally review the deliverable and remain transparent about AI assistance. I will not secretly violate a client’s no-AI policy.

**Location:** Alberta, Canada — Mountain Time.
**Availability:** Remote/asynchronous evenings and weekends.
**Portfolio:** https://github.com/Lornt1666/RegenExcalibur/blob/main/FREELANCE_PROFILE.md

If your problem doesn’t fit neatly into one of the categories above, **send it anyway**. DM me with the problem, desired outcome/deliverable, deadline, approximate budget, relevant files/data, and whether AI-assisted work is permitted. I’ll tell you what I can responsibly coordinate, what would require outside professional review, and how I would approach it.

— Justice Gray Maciocha / 1JGM
Founder/Operator, RegenExcalibur
